parsed.restated: ∀ language : BitLanguage, IsNP language = true → ∃ map : List Bool → List Bool, Nonempty (GapCVP.BitTM map) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, language input = true → yesLanguage input = true) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, ¬ (language input = true) → noLanguage input = true)
parsed.proof:
unfold IsNPHardPromise
simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
constructor
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := h language hl
  exact ⟨r.map, r.polynomial_time, r.completeness, r.soundness⟩
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hc, hs⟩ := h language hl
  exact ⟨⟨m, hm, hc, hs⟩⟩
parsed.english: Every language in NP has a polynomial-time computable map on bit strings that sends members of the language to encodings of YES instances of GapCVP (factor n^(1/400)) and non-members to encodings of NO instances.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the Bool-encoded NP-hardness and the PromiseReduction structure into explicit conditions on a map (completeness and soundness), and it avoids mentioning the sorry-carrying promise-problem object.
